spec.name: Orange Kitchen Garlic Bread
spec.description: Four thick baguette slices with stepped golden crusts, open ivory crumb, melting butter and small roasted garlic pieces. Grounded at y=0 with a bold, appetizing inventory silhouette.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Garlic Bread. Golden sliced bread with crumb face, toasted crust, butter and herbs if appropriate. Actual recipe ingredients: bread, butter, garlic. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
